name: Conversion
summary: All-black paid-ads agency site with a floating pill nav, centred grotesk headlines that swap one word to an italic serif, and a molten red-orange glow rising from the hero floor.

fonts.pairing: Satoshi 500 with -0.04em tracking for headings; one word per heading set in Instrument Serif italic; Satoshi 500 for body at 56% white

signature: blurred red, orange and white glow blooming from the bottom of the hero like a sunrise
single italic serif word inside each centred heading
service cards on near-black with a coloured gradient bleeding in from one corner
two-column comparison: muted list for other agencies versus a glowing card with checkmarks
imagery: almost no photography; gradient glows, client logos, small avatars and Lottie icons on black
layout_grid: 1072px content (1200 frame, 64px sides), 64px section padding, everything centred, 24px card radius, fully round pills and avatars, 12% white borders
